Title: Lake Kawaguchi : Private Half-Day Tour with local guide
Description:
Half day private tour will take you to explore around Mt. Fuji. Most of the places around Lake kawaguchi need car/bus access. Why don't you take our short private tour and save your time for sightseeing.

-Private tour for 4-5 hours including pick-up and drop-off
-Free pick up& drop off
-Flexible tour by your request
-Guided by local English Speaking guide
-Mini Van with luggage storage
-Starts time between 8:30 am to 13:00pm

We will pick you up at hotel in the morning and head to visit sightseeing places you would like to visit. Recommended places are given by your guide as well.

[example of the half day tour]
8:30 : pick you up at your hotel
9:30 : Lake Motosu for morning view
10:30 : Visiting Kitaguchi sengen shrine & Oshino hakkai
11:30 : Visiting Lake Yamanaka and view point
12:30 : Back to your hotel or Kawaguchiko Station.

We have availability to drop you off at Mishima station or Hakone Area. If you need a option, please ask us before booking.

Title: Mt. Fuji Private Tour w/ local English speaking guide & activity
Description:
Experience the Mt. Fuji region on a high-quality, fully customizable 8-to-9 hour private tour. Your entire day is built around your interests and pace.

Your dedicated, English-speaking local guide is an expert in culture, history, and outdoor activities, offering insights that only insiders know.

[Your Personalized Day]
-Total Customization: You choose where to visit! Your guide offers expert recommendations to design your perfect itinerary within 8 to 9 flexible hours.

-All-Inclusive: All entrance fees are covered.

-Door-to-Door Service: Free pick-up/drop-off across the wider area (Lake Kawaguchi, Mishima/Shinfuji Stations, Fujinomiya, Hakone). Please check the information for pick-up.

-Amenities: Includes water & snacks and a hand-made tourism booklet.

[Optional Adventures]
Hiking: Choose from several options tailored to your ability and time.

Fishing: All fishing gear is provided; your guide knows the best local spots.

Biking: We can enjoy short biking tour around a lake
